name: Grainient
description: WebGL2 animated gradient background with flowing warped color bands, silky shading, film grain, and pointer stirring with click swirls. Fills its parent container.
contents: Container div with a single full-size canvas rendered by two WebGL2 shader passes (gradient field and grain composite)
behavior: Gradient flows continuously through noise warping, linear or radial
Pointer movement over the window stirs the gradient with a fading trail
Click or tap inside the container creates a twirl swirl
Intro animation fades the gradient in over about 1.6 seconds
Rendering pauses when offscreen or the tab is hidden
Reduced motion preference disables flow, grain animation, stirring, swirls and intro
Light mode lifts and inverts the palette toward white tints
editableByProps: Palette (up to 8 colors), gradient type, angle, band count, scale and softness
Motion: speed, flow amount, variation seed, intro on or off
Look: silk shading, contrast, saturation, light mode
Interaction: pointer stirring, stir strength, click swirl
Render pixel ratio cap and container className, style, extra DOM props

needsCodeEdit.change: Change stir or swirl radius and lifetime
needsCodeEdit.where: STIR_LIFE, TWIRL_LIFE constants and the 0.045 falloff and twirl radius values in updateTouches and FIELD shader
grainClock > 1 / 24 check in the frame function

fixed: Requires WebGL2; renders nothing if unavailable
Fills the parent, so the parent needs a defined height
Uses at most 8 colors, extra colors are ignored
Pointer and click listeners are attached to window, so stirring responds to the whole page while the pointer is over the container
Gradient field renders at half canvas resolution
Respects prefers-reduced-motion, read once on mount

options.look: Directional gradient flowing along the set angle with warped bands
options.useWhen: Full-width hero or section backdrop behind headline text

options.look: Gradient radiating from the center with a slowly rotating warp
options.useWhen: Centered spotlight style backdrop for a single product or call-to-action block
